about: Audio-only pronunciation dictionary for KIMBLE Rocket Engineering narration. Applied to each cue's text before G2P; captions are never changed. Keys are whole words or phrases (matched on word boundaries, longest key first; spaces in a key match any run of whitespace). A key containing an uppercase letter matches case-sensitively, otherwise case-insensitively (override with "caseSensitive"). An alphabetic key also matches its inflections -s, -es, -'s, -s', -ed, -ing; phoneme entries then get misaki's suffix rules (e.g. resist -> resists, die -> dies). Each entry has exactly one of: "say" = a respelling substituted into the audio text and then read normally, or "phonemes" = Kokoro v1.0 / misaki British phonemes used verbatim (a string, or an object keyed by NOUN / VERB / ADJ / DEFAULT for noun-verb pairs). Symbols: A=eɪ I=aɪ Q=əʊ W=aʊ Y=ɔɪ ʤ ʧ, ᵊ = light schwa, a = TRAP, ɑː = PALM, ɒ = LOT, ɔː = THOUGHT, ɜː = NURSE, ː = long, ˈ primary and ˌ secondary stress (placed just before the stressed vowel). Optional "asr" lists transcriptions the automatic ASR check should accept for this entry (QA only; it never changes the audio). Where the audio should say different WORDS from the caption (e.g. 'deep ultraviolet' for 'DUV'), write those words in the script instead, so captions and speech match.
